Monitor travel movements of expatriate personnel and provide security guidance when required. Coordinate travel security arrangements, including route assessments, secure transportation, and contingency planning. Provide security advice regarding travel restrictions, high-risk areas, and emerging threats. Crisis and Incident Management Investigate security incidents and prepare comprehensive reports with recommendations. Maintain incident tracking and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Security Operations Advise/support the management of office security systems, access control measures, and guard force operations. Direct the Administration Department to conduct regular security inspections and audits of company facilities and ensure compliance with established security requirements. The Security Advisor shall ensure that CCTV, access control systems, alarm systems, lighting, barriers, gates, and other physical security systems are functional, properly monitored, and periodically tested.
